notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase and Demo Overhaul!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that Starpuffs is being included in this year's [b]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/b], which runs through [b]May 29th[/b] and [b]June 5th[/b] 2025!

To celebrate, we have completely reworked the [b]Starpuffs Demo![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651050/?snr=1_5_9__205
The demo now includes select levels from all [b]5 zones[/b], in order to give you a better taste of the different mechanics and puzzles in the full game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709037/a44dc745ac53e5e84097fd41c83ef493afad5ce4.jpg[/img]

We have also made both the demo and the full game more compatible with different screen resolutions.

Thank you for all your support and we wish you all a very pleasant week!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709037/fe1402d9604c6cb849e8ead9c43eae146591d005.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Update - February 2025
notes.notes:
Our first update of 2025 includes the following:
[list]
[*]Christmas is long over! Cloudy has put away her festive hat on the shelf for now. The visuals in the Main Menu and Zone Select have been reverted back to their originals.
[*]The "Accessibility" options are now more cheerful (and bouncy).
[*]Added more tutorial hints to Level 5 and Level 6.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor patch regarding "Best time" in levels
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the developer of Starpuffs here.

We have come across a minor bug that occasionally occurs when quitting the game; which causes the "Best time" text in the level select maps to be reset and show "Not completed yet" even though you have already completed the level.

We are hoping that this bug is now fixed and we appreciate your understanding if it has happened to you.

Happy collecting!

notes.title: Starpuffs is Finally Out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that Starpuffs is finally available for you to enjoy! We really hope that you have a wonderful time playing!

[h1]What's in the Full Game?[/h1]

[list]
[*] 4 separate Save Files showing your progression in each one
[*] 5 unique zones each with 25 levels and unique environmental mechanics, totalling up to 125 levels
[*] Two game modes: Story Mode and Casual Mode
[*] Full controller support
[*] Mouse support for menus
[*] Tutorial levels (level 1 through 4) now explain the gameplay better
[*] 19 Steam achievements
[/list]

[h1]A Minor Tweak Since Launch[/h1]

[b]"Complete" and "Perfect" levels now have a clearer visual representation on the map. Previously, complete levels were coloured in silver and perfect levels in gold. However, we received feedback that the silver colouring might confuse players and cause them to think they have NOT properly completed the level. We would like everyone to know that "perfecting" a level is merely a personal achievement and is NOT required to fully beat the game.[/b]


We appreciate your feedback and are happy to continue making Starpuffs more enjoyable for all of you.

Happy collecting!

notes.title: Demo Update V1.3
notes.notes:
[h3]Thanks to all your feedback, we have made some small, yet important changes![/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed the bug that prevented controller input to be read properly (hopefully).
[*]Added mouse support for menu navigation, and a cute cursor to come with it!
[*]Changed the default music volume to not be as loud as before when starting the game for the first time.
[*]Swapped the “golden and silver star badges” that you gain after completing a level with a single, special star badge.
[*]Updated one of the level backgrounds to be more coherent with the other backgrounds.
[*]Now you can walk on any tile on the level select map. Level tiles now show how many badges you need in order to unlock the levels.
[/list]

[h3]Thank you for all the support! Much love![/h3]

notes.title: Demo Update V1.2 and Official Discord Server Live!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce our first update to the [b]Starpuffs Demo[/b]! It's a moderately small update with some quality-of-life improvements and tiny bugfixes. Also, our official Discord server is now live and waiting for you to jump in!

You can access the [b]Discord server[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/KCrz447v]here.[/url]

[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the name of [b]Extras [/b]in the Options menu to [b]Accessibility[/b]. We thought this was a more appropriate name.
[*] Added a [b]level timer[/b] that goes off right after you make your first move in a level.
[*] Added an indicator to the [b]Level Select Screen[/b] that shows your best time for each level and your best time total.
[*]Added a [b]Display Timer[/b] option that can be toggled in the [b]Accessibility[/b] menu. Note that this turns off the best time and total time indicators as well. However, your best times will still be recorded and saved in the background should you decide to turn it back on again.
[*]Added[b] visual movement indicators[/b] on the player to show which cloud moves in what direction more clearly.
[*]Added a button in the [b]Accessibility[/b] menu to toggle the movement indicators on and off. Turning off the arrows replaces them with a dashed circle around specific clouds to help distinguish between them, and vice versa.
[*]Added a button in the main menu that directs the user to the official [b]Starpuffs Discord Server[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed [/b]a bug where undoing a move sometimes caused the player to drop their stars when they shouldn't have.
[*][b]Fixed [/b]a bug that causes multiple sound effects to play all at once when opening the Accessibility menu.
[/list]
